policy_disclaimer: Demonstration Policy Disclaimer: Evidence Quality Index (EQI) and Reliability metrics are project-defined heuristic demonstration policies for agentic evaluation, not official mathematical probabilities or regulatory standards.

Tier 1: Peer-reviewed research.description: Formally peer-reviewed scientific and engineering research publications with methodology disclosure.
Tier 1: Peer-reviewed research.disclosure_rule: Full inclusion with highest synthesis weight.

Tier 2: Independent benchmark.description: Independent reproducible benchmarks, consortium evaluations, and open academic test suites.
Tier 2: Independent benchmark.disclosure_rule: Full inclusion with secondary synthesis weight.

Tier 3: Vendor engineering blog.description: Commercial engineering blogs, product whitepapers, and corporate technical reports.
Tier 3: Vendor engineering blog.disclosure_rule: Full disclosure without suppression, discounted synthesis weight, and commercial caveat.

formulas.governance_rule: If max_severity >= 1.0, status is CONTESTED_TIER_1_CONFLICT and human_review_required is True.
